name: media-tracker
description: Private, single-user media history and learning tracker

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @media-tracker/domain build && pnpm --filter @media-tracker/db build && pnpm --filter @media-tracker/contracts build && pnpm --filter @media-tracker/web build && pnpm --filter @media-tracker/api build && pnpm --filter @media-tracker/cli build
scripts.build:production: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @media-tracker/web build:production && pnpm --filter @media-tracker/api build:production
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.check:all: pnpm check && pnpm build:production && vitest run --config vitest.runtime.config.ts && pnpm test:e2e && playwright test --config playwright.acceptance.config.ts
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm --filter @media-tracker/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply media-tracker --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: pnpm --filter @media-tracker/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply media-tracker --remote
